items.description: Waymo 宣布进入加拿大，将在多伦多布局完全自动驾驶出行服务，目标2028年迎接首批乘客。近期将先以人工驾驶方式采集高精地图并由自动驾驶专家进行测试；Waymo 与 Element Fleet Management 合作提供车队管理服务，将逐步创造数百个岗位。官方称基于超4亿公里完全自动驾驶里程，其车辆在严重伤害及以上事故中比人类驾驶少95%。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/xwgy3mhme6nur9kndswxlu0es

items.title: 丹麦最高法院裁定持有传播 AI 生成儿童色情内容可判实刑
items.description: 据彭博社 15 日报道，丹麦最高法院维持对一名 31 岁男子 18 个月监禁的判决，该男子因持有并传播 3.6 万余张 AI 生成的儿童色情图像获刑，且不适用缓刑。法院裁定，即使图像无真实人物原型，也受丹麦《刑法》约束，量刑时不应考虑人物是否虚构；此案为丹麦首起此类定罪，并引发跨国调查，警方查明 273 名买家身份、逮捕 25 人。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/bvljy29i9xwh3wnkwign3npt4

items.description: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
items.author: Aditya Mehta
items.content: Last day to save up to $200 to TechCrunch Founder Summit on Oct. 16. Register now. Disrupt doors open Oct. 13. Get your pass and bring someone with you at 50% off. REGISTER NOW. AI agents from multiple providers accessed personal data and confidential material at Indian organizations during research and testing, India’s cybersecurity agency said Thursday. The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) said it had received “multiple voluntary disclosures from AI model providers” whose models, during research and evaluation runs on the open internet, “had reached the live systems of Indian organizations.” The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles, and their actions “exceeded the authorisation of their assigned tasks.” This makes India the latest stop on what has become a world tour for rogue AI agents. In July, OpenAI’s agents escaped a test environment and hacked French company Hugging Face — kicking off a summer of rogue AI agent activity. Last month, OpenAI apologized to Australia after its agents accessed four government websites, including a Medicare statistics portal.

items.author: Aditya Mehta
items.content: Last day to save up to $200 to TechCrunch Founder Summit on Oct. 16. Register now. Disrupt doors open Oct. 13. Get your pass and bring someone with you at 50% off. REGISTER NOW. Elorian , the Palo Alto AI startup that raised a $55 million seed round at a $300 million valuation before it launched a product, released its first model on Friday, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. The model, Glimpse , is launching as a research preview with API access and a chat interface. The thesis? Today’s AI models, for all their skill with language and code, still can’t really see. Most multimodal models look at an image once, convert it to tokens, and then reason about it in text — like describing a photo from memory. Glimpse keeps going back to the source. Mid-reasoning, it can crop into a region, pull specific frames from a video, or run code to measure or compare what it’s looking at, a mechanism Elorian calls a “visual scratch space.” Think of someone pinching to zoom on a phone photo to double-check what they thought they saw. For former Google DeepMind researcher and Elorian CEO Andrew Dai, one of the clearest signs that AI still couldn’t really see came on game night.

Jev has become the fastest adopted AI model ever — at least by some measures. Vercel data published on Thursday shows that, within two weeks of its launch, the buzzy decision model was being used by 35% of paid teams, with nearly double the reach of the second most popular model, Sonnet 5.5. It’s the fastest adoption a model has ever seen in its first two weeks, according to Vercel’s data, and a major accomplishment for the model’s creators, TypeSafe AI. Published in limited release on September 15, Jev is designed as a lightweight tool for choosing between a few predetermined outputs. Limiting the outputs lets the model run cheaper and faster than alternatives like Sonnet, making it ideal for classifying large quantities of data quickly.
